public_body: Fall River City Council Committee On Ordinances And Legislation
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the February 15, 2024 notice had a wrong weekday (Tuesday instead of Thursday), but it was posted 48 hours ahead with the correct date, time, and place, and the error was unlikely to confuse the public. The AG only encouraged greater care.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee failed to properly post notice for its February 15, 2024 meeting because the notice listed the wrong day of the week.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Open Meeting Law requires that a notice include the date of a meeting, rather than the day, and the correct date, as well as time and place, were included in the meeting notice here, we do not find a violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Part of the posting challenge concerned whether notice for the February 15, 2024 meeting was posted far enough in advance.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Committee posted notice for its February 15, 2024, meeting 48 hours in advance, and included the correct date, time, and place in the meeting notice.
